item.title: Leveraging AI to Enhance Educational Opportunities in K-12
item.description: The role of artificial intelligence (AI) in enhancing educational opportunities for K-12 students is grounded on the premise that AI technologies can significantly overcome traditional barriers that K-12 educators often encounter in the classroom. item.title: Artificial Intelligence in Teacher Practice: Insights from a Pilot Study
item.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has taken the education field by storm. Yet mixed messages have left educators uncertain about how to approach the technology in practice. This pilot study examined how K-12 in-service teachers use AI tools in their teaching and how they characterize their experiences. item.title: A Comparative DBR Evaluation for the Four Mainstream GenAI Tools in Designing PBL for 9-12 STEM Education
item.description: This comparative study investigates the different emphases of the four mainstream GenAI tools when adopted to design interdisciplinary learning projects for the 9-12 STEM education. It addresses a gap in understanding the specialties of GenAI tools when used to support instructional design in STEM education (Zekaj, 2023). item.title: Mapping Empirical Evidence on Artificial Intelligence Tools for Mathematics Teachers: A Scoping Review
item.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping education, yet its integration into K–12 mathematics remains limited. This scoping review synthesizes 7 empirical studies (2022–2025). The primary purpose of this review is to explore the benefits, challenges, and gaps in AI integration in mathematics. This review is guided by Arksey and O'Malley's scoping review framework. item.title: Efficiency evaluation of different methods for nitrogen removal in municipal wastewater treatment plants: An integrative review
item.description: Domestic wastewaters present high nitrogen levels due to the urea and ammonia, which are excreted into urine.
